raw_text: {"relevant_claims":["Even so, the policy effective on the decision date must be retrieved, or confirmed with pricing_desk, before finalizing.","The decision date of 2026-10-05 is outside the effective windows of both PRC-2026.1 (ends 2026-09-01, exclusive) and PRC-2025.1 (ends 2026-04-01).","The request also clears PRC-2025.1's 30% micro minimum margin and 15% discount threshold."],"evidence_ids":["PRC-2026.1§1","PRC-2025.1§1","PRC-2026.1§8","FACT-decision_date","PRC-2025.1§3","PRC-2025.1§4","FACT-request","FACT-current_pricing"],"explanation":"No material claim is unsupported.
